subject.title: fix(agents): avoid symlink-follow in auth.json bootstrap

question: Should the no-final-path-chmod and exact-mode guarantee remain an OpenClaw wrapper contract, or should `@openclaw/fs-safe` own it so OpenClaw continues to delegate directly?
rationale: The contributor explicitly presented these as alternative permanent ownership boundaries, and current main has returned to direct fs-safe delegation; selecting the lasting security contract requires maintainer intent.

options.title: Use the upstream contract
options.body: Rebase the PR, remove the local replacement wrapper, and keep only the auth bootstrap change if the current fs-safe implementation already supplies the required no-follow and mode semantics.

options.title: Approve a local wrapper
options.body: Keep a narrowly documented OpenClaw wrapper only if reviewers confirm fs-safe cannot safely provide this contract and accept OpenClaw as the long-term owner.

recommendation.title: Use the upstream contract
recommendation.body: Rebase the PR, remove the local replacement wrapper, and keep only the auth bootstrap change if the current fs-safe implementation already supplies the required no-follow and mode semantics.

likelyOwner.reason: This group was explicitly asked to decide the shared filesystem-security ownership boundary.
